title: Gowers Cauchy–Schwarz inequality
statement: Let $k$ be a positive integer and let $F$ assign a real-valued function on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ to each $s\in\mathbb{F}_2^k$. Its Gowers inner product is at most the product, over all $s\in\mathbb{F}_2^k$, of the order-$k$ Gowers norms of the functions $F(s)$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued family $F$ indexed by $\mathbb{F}_2^k$ and points of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$
